Rabri Devi Given Ultimatum to Vacate Patna Bungalow

Former Bihar Chief Minister Rabri Devi has received a final notice from the Building Construction Department to vacate her official bungalow in Patna. She has been given seven days to do so, with a deadline reportedly set for June 29. The situation involves a dispute over the possession of the government accommodation.
